hypothesis: Recent amplitude and within-window change may help FoG boundaries; improvement is not assumed
recent_preprocessing: Split the existing full-window 0.5-20Hz filtered signal into two 60-sample halves; all features available at window end
outer_folds: Reuse frozen subject assignments from the readiness baseline training report
comparison: Both new arms use identical grouped-inner threshold selection; historical OOB is reference only
deployment_threshold: Median of the five outer-training selected thresholds; never used to replace OOF thresholds
selection_policy: Run one declared candidate, report all arms; do not auto-replace the project default
evaluation: Window metrics, raw sample event coverage/time overlap, subject/activity strata, fixed historical case plots
limitations: Window-label FoG detection, not onset prediction
No step-response model or treatment experiment
Existing test people have been examined in past project analysis; this is not an untouched external test set
